admission.goal: Autonomously deliver real current five-student Backend DB and private teacher site under kcpalantir.tech, with extensible hierarchical typed evidence, book replacement history, selective/whole refresh and shared human/WebMCP logic.
admission.initialCoverage: Current source enrollment/books/progress and recent lesson/result evidence first; qualified history follows.
admission.refresh: Click-driven selected student/book/lesson and explicit whole-cohort refresh; no continuous full polling or mandatory scheduler.
admission.secrets: Native vault/official provider login only; no browser-cookie extraction, credential dumps or second academy session store.

architecture.store: Actual Backend PostgreSQL 18.6; private active-profile academy directory, peer-authenticated Unix socket, data checksums, no TCP listener.
architecture.namespaceRule: Original source keys and video/board/paper/attempt labels remain distinct; no name-only joins, manufactured LEC identities or example-as-record conversion.
architecture.sourceMeaning: Course learning range is not inferred effective enrollment; source registration is not teacher-confirmed primary/supplementary role; stored grade is not inspection/mastery; missing rows are not nonperformance.
architecture.nativeOwnership: No dispatcher, native state mirror, per-turn context injector, installed engine modification or unrestricted worker.

actualBackend.bindings: Authenticated current instructor/student cells and three passive course tuples corroborated against independent name/grouped-row and course/book/student progress tuples for every admitted subject.
actualBackend.privateData: Actual names/keys/source payloads/configuration remain outside Git. One requested subject has one currently observed book; no extra book or missing-work assertion was fabricated.
actualBackend.lookupAcceptance: All five DB partitions and exact source registration data were read back; teacher/application queries are owner-filtered.

realRefresh.consumer: SourceRefreshCoordinator -> nativeBookAcquirer -> existing native browser_exec/browser_vault_list/browser_vault_fill -> reviewed fixed source reads -> sourceBridge -> PostgreSQL append/readback
realRefresh.selectedScope: One actual student/native source refresh succeeded.
realRefresh.authentication: Existing origin-bound native saved academy login used by actual native handlers; no password/cookie/token entered the product payload.
realRefresh.claimLimit: This exact current local native route worked; not a guarantee of all future MFA, manager unlock, native cleanup, source layouts or arbitrary unattended operation.
realRefresh.expiryBehavior: Blocked acquisition preserves original successful heads/time and does not claim a current refresh.
realRefresh.duplicateRepair: Actual repeat found an observation-clock-bearing capture reference manufacturing revisions. RED case isolated it; stable per-field provenance now separates content changes from newer verification time. Prior revisions are retained.

privateSite.dns: New CNAME provisioned without overwrite; independent Google DNS returned current A answers.
privateSite.readback: Official tunnel metadata and readiness showed four active connector links; actual HTTPS health route returned running. Anonymous /api/cohort returned 401 with no student data.
privateSite.authentication: Single teacher signed session, native-vault password setup, password hash only, secure HttpOnly SameSite cookie, one-use persisted invitation, Origin guard, login throttling, restrictive CSP and no raw HTML rendering.
privateSite.blocker: Native save-login prompt for the new site returned save_declined. No second request or secret-input workaround was attempted. Teacher credential registration is incomplete and student disclosure remains blocked.
privateSite.webMcp: Owned browser adapter uses the same protected application query with standard input/annotation/execute fields when document.modelContext is available. Actual authenticated discovery/invocation is not established; no shim/flags/academy injection.

recovery.format: Canonical portable bundle encrypted with authenticated AES-256-GCM; tamper/wrong-key refusal tested.
recovery.consistentSnapshot: Actual PostgreSQL repeatable-read exported snapshot consumed by pg_dump; full owned schema, revisions, catalog dependencies, heads, relations and original outcomes retained.
recovery.actualRestore: Decrypted and imported into a newly created empty dc_academy_restore_20261004 database; all five original/restored teacher query results compared exactly.
recovery.limit: Copy/key/restore are on this Backend. This is actual local recovery, not an independent off-Backend copy/key placement or lossless future restoration.

validation.localRealPostgresTests: Actual provider/HTTP/partition/source/retry/shared-catalog/recovery tests ran against a separate synthetic test DB; real student intake/query/refresh/restore are separate acceptance witnesses.
validation.portableGate: cloud:check passed with exact source-integrity and pinned toolchain; current academy suite is included. Missing PG test socket causes explicitly reported skips, not production PASS.
validation.typechecks: Root, harness and existing agent-runtime checks retained.
validation.confidentiality: Review explicit staged paths/diff and run audit:staged before publication; no actual student records, invitation URL, keys, passwords or provider credentials are publication inputs.
validation.reviewMode: Lead source/security self-review, real local execution and exact-head CI; no independent worker verdict claimed.

preservedFailures: Initial browser read hit the native five-second IPC wait, then native idle cleanup; no success was fabricated. Supported CDP per-call wait and immediate post-login capture produced actual five-subject data.
Coordinate login click opened a presentation-only registration panel; it was dismissed and exact native .webSend login handler used. No membership form/save was submitted.

PG source bootstrap found missing bison/flex/m4. Build tools were extracted only to the owned runtime from official HTTPS Debian metadata/package hashes; absent gpgv signature verification was explicitly not claimed.
Actual provider rejected double-encoded JSON references; explicit text-to-jsonb binding corrected it without relaxing constraints.
